paragraphs: R' Pedat son of R' Elazar (ben Pedat). R' Elazar instructed R' Pedat his son: Berakhot 11b, 56a; Mo'ed Katan 20a. R' Zeira said to R' Pedat, ‘See, from you and from your father,’ etc. Rashi explains: R' Pedat bar R' Elazar ben Pedat; Niddah 8a. Tosafot there: although R' Elazar's sons died (see there), nevertheless this son remained to him.
These are those who spoke in R' Pedat's name; in some cases it is uncertain whether in the name of R' Pedat the Elder or R' Pedat his grandson.

In R' Hoshaya's name: Jerusalem Talmud Bava Kamma 4:7:2 [Heilprin: 4:8] and Jerusalem Talmud Shevuot 8:3:4. R' Haggai in his name. R' Hanan bar Ammi [the retrieved Bavli reads Rav Huna bar Ammi] said that R' Pedat said that R' Yohanan said. R' Yehoshua ben Levi in R' Pedat's name (it seems to me that it should read Pedaya, mentioned above: since he spoke in R' Yohanan's name, how could R' Yehoshua ben Levi speak in his name?): Jerusalem Talmud, Tefillat Ha-Shahar and Ha-Motze Tefillin. R' Yohanan is mentioned [נז״ר יוחנן; compact wording unresolved] (see above). In R' Yaakov bar Idi's name. R' Yitzhak bar Bisna questioned him. R' Yitzhak ben Elazar eulogized him [the received Bavli names R' Yohanan as the deceased]; Mo'ed Katan 25b.
